units.title: Advanced #1: Negative Adverbial: Not only... but also (Inversiya)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Not only + yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l, but (ega) also...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Negative Adverbial: Not only... but also (Inversiya). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Not only + yordamchi fe'l + ega + asosiy fe'l, but (ega) also...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Negative Adverbial: Not only... but also (Inversiya).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Not only does unbridled urbanisation strain local infrastructure, but it also exacerbates social alienation among citizens.” Examiner Note: Yordamchi fe'l 'does/do/did' egadan oldinga o'tadi; ikkinchi qismda inversiya bo'lmaydi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Inkor ravishlar gap boshida. Never, rarely, seldom, hardly, little, not only, no sooner gap boshiga chiqsa, ega bilan fe'l o'rni almashadi: «Never have emissions fallen so quickly». Yordamchi fe'l qo'shiladi, asosiy fe'l asl shaklda qoladi.

Not only ... but also. «Not only did the policy reduce emissions, but it also created jobs». Birinchi qismda inversiya, ikkinchi qismda oddiy tartib. Bu tuzilma ikki afzallikni bitta gapda birlashtiradi.

Shart gap inversiyasi. if tushirilib, inversiya qo'llanadi: «Had the government acted earlier, the crisis would have been avoided», «Should the trend continue, costs will rise», «Were the city to invest more, traffic would fall». Bu juda rasmiy va ta'sirchan.

Tuzoqlar. Inversiya faqat inkor yoki cheklov ma'nosi bilan ishlaydi; oddiy gapni inversiya qilib bo'lmaydi. Bundan tashqari, yordamchi fe'l to'g'ri tanlanishi kerak: «Never the city has seen...» emas, «Never has the city seen...».

units.title: Advanced #4: Exclusive Focus: Only by + Gerund
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Only by + V-ing + yordamchi/modal fe'l + ega + fe'l...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Exclusive Focus: Only by + Gerund. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Only by + V-ing + yordamchi/modal fe'l + ega + fe'l...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Exclusive Focus: Only by + Gerund.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Only by instituting progressive taxation policies can governments redress the widening wealth gap.” Examiner Note: Yagona samarali yechimni tavsiya qilishda essening Body 2 yoki Conclusion qismida juda qo'l keladi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Inkor ravishlar gap boshida. Never, rarely, seldom, hardly, little, not only, no sooner gap boshiga chiqsa, ega bilan fe'l o'rni almashadi: «Never have emissions fallen so quickly». Yordamchi fe'l qo'shiladi, asosiy fe'l asl shaklda qoladi.

Not only ... but also. «Not only did the policy reduce emissions, but it also created jobs». Birinchi qismda inversiya, ikkinchi qismda oddiy tartib. Bu tuzilma ikki afzallikni bitta gapda birlashtiradi.

Shart gap inversiyasi. if tushirilib, inversiya qo'llanadi: «Had the government acted earlier, the crisis would have been avoided», «Should the trend continue, costs will rise», «Were the city to invest more, traffic would fall». Bu juda rasmiy va ta'sirchan.

Tuzoqlar. Inversiya faqat inkor yoki cheklov ma'nosi bilan ishlaydi; oddiy gapni inversiya qilib bo'lmaydi. Bundan tashqari, yordamchi fe'l to'g'ri tanlanishi kerak: «Never the city has seen...» emas, «Never has the city seen...».

units.title: Advanced #5: Temporal Limitation: Only when / Only after
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Only after/when + ergash gap + yordamchi fe'l + bosh gap egasi + fe'l...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Temporal Limitation: Only when / Only after. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Only after/when + ergash gap + yordamchi fe'l + bosh gap egasi + fe'l...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Temporal Limitation: Only when / Only after.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Only when public transit becomes reliably accessible will commuters willingly abandon private motor vehicles.” Examiner Note: Inversiya faqat bosh gapda yuz beradi, 'only when/after' ergash gapida emas.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Inkor ravishlar gap boshida. Never, rarely, seldom, hardly, little, not only, no sooner gap boshiga chiqsa, ega bilan fe'l o'rni almashadi: «Never have emissions fallen so quickly». Yordamchi fe'l qo'shiladi, asosiy fe'l asl shaklda qoladi.

Not only ... but also. «Not only did the policy reduce emissions, but it also created jobs». Birinchi qismda inversiya, ikkinchi qismda oddiy tartib. Bu tuzilma ikki afzallikni bitta gapda birlashtiradi.

Shart gap inversiyasi. if tushirilib, inversiya qo'llanadi: «Had the government acted earlier, the crisis would have been avoided», «Should the trend continue, costs will rise», «Were the city to invest more, traffic would fall». Bu juda rasmiy va ta'sirchan.

Tuzoqlar. Inversiya faqat inkor yoki cheklov ma'nosi bilan ishlaydi; oddiy gapni inversiya qilib bo'lmaydi. Bundan tashqari, yordamchi fe'l to'g'ri tanlanishi kerak: «Never the city has seen...» emas, «Never has the city seen...».

Shart gap inversiyasi. if tushirilib, inversiya qo'llanadi: «Had the government acted earlier, the crisis would have been avoided», «Should the trend continue, costs will rise», «Were the city to invest more, traffic would fall». Bu juda rasmiy va ta'sirchan.

units.title: Advanced #7: Proportional Result: So + Adjective... that
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: So + sifat + be + ega + that + ergash gap...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Proportional Result: So + Adjective... that. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: So + sifat + be + ega + that + ergash gap...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Proportional Result: So + Adjective... that.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “So severe is the shortage of affordable housing in metropolitan hubs that young professionals are priced out of city centres.” Examiner Note: Muammoning ko'lami va uning muqarrar oqibatini bog'lash uchun ideal sintaksis.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: too va enough. too + sifat + to + infinitiv: «The rent is too high to afford». enough sifatdan keyin keladi: «The rent is not low enough for young families». enough ot oldida ham kelishi mumkin: «enough money», «enough time».

so ... that. so + sifat/ravish + that: «Housing is so expensive that many young people cannot buy». Shuningdek so many/so much + ot + that: «So many people applied that the system crashed». Bu tuzilma natijani kuchli ifodalaydi.

such ... that. such + (a/an) + sifat + ot + that: «It was such a serious problem that the government intervened». Ko'plik va sanalmaydigan otlar bilan a/an siz: «such high prices», «such rapid growth».

so va such farqi. so sifat yoki ravish bilan, such ot birikmasi bilan ishlatiladi: «so expensive» va «such an expensive city». «such expensive» xato, agar ot bo'lmasa. Bu farq imtihonda tez-tez uchraydigan xatodir.

units.title: Advanced #11: Present Participle (Sabab bildiruvchi)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: V-ing..., ega + fe'l...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Present Participle (Sabab bildiruvchi). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: V-ing..., ega + fe'l...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Present Participle (Sabab bildiruvchi).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Fearing severe macroeconomic instability, central banks routinely elevate benchmark interest rates during inflationary spirals.” Examiner Note: 'Because they fear...' o'rniga qo'llanilib, so'z tejamkorligi va ravonlikni ta'minlaydi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Bir vaqtda bo'lgan harakat. Ikki harakat bir vaqtda bo'lsa: «Walking through the city centre, visitors notice the contrast between old and new». -ing qismdagi harakatning egasi bosh gapdagi ega bilan bir xil bo'lishi kerak (visitors).

Sabab va natija. -ing clause sababni ham bildiradi: «Facing rising rents, many families moved to the suburbs» = «Because they faced rising rents...». Bu tuzilma because dan qisqaroq va akademikroq, lekin sabab aniq bo'lishi kerak.

Dangling participle xatosi. Eng katta xato: -ing qismning egasi bosh gapdagi ega bilan mos kelmasligi. «Walking down the street, the buildings looked old» — binolar yurmagan. To'g'risi: «Walking down the street, I noticed that the buildings looked old».

Ketma-ket harakatlar. Bir egaga tegishli ketma-ket harakatlarni ham bog'lash mumkin: «The government introduced new rules, aiming to reduce emissions». Bu tuzilma hisobot va tahliliy matnda juda keng ishlatiladi.

units.title: Advanced #12: Present Participle (Natija bildiruvchi: Resultative)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Bosh gap, thereby + V-ing...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Present Participle (Natija bildiruvchi: Resultative). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Bosh gap, thereby + V-ing...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Present Participle (Natija bildiruvchi: Resultative).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Municipal authorities subsidized electric mobility, thereby curtailing vehicular emissions across the metropolitan zone.” Examiner Note: Avvalgi harakatning bevosita mantiqiy oqibatini ifodalashda eng yuqori baholanuvchi vosita.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Bir vaqtda bo'lgan harakat. Ikki harakat bir vaqtda bo'lsa: «Walking through the city centre, visitors notice the contrast between old and new». -ing qismdagi harakatning egasi bosh gapdagi ega bilan bir xil bo'lishi kerak (visitors).

Sabab va natija. -ing clause sababni ham bildiradi: «Facing rising rents, many families moved to the suburbs» = «Because they faced rising rents...». Bu tuzilma because dan qisqaroq va akademikroq, lekin sabab aniq bo'lishi kerak.

Dangling participle xatosi. Eng katta xato: -ing qismning egasi bosh gapdagi ega bilan mos kelmasligi. «Walking down the street, the buildings looked old» — binolar yurmagan. To'g'risi: «Walking down the street, I noticed that the buildings looked old».

Ketma-ket harakatlar. Bir egaga tegishli ketma-ket harakatlarni ham bog'lash mumkin: «The government introduced new rules, aiming to reduce emissions». Bu tuzilma hisobot va tahliliy matnda juda keng ishlatiladi.

units.title: Advanced #14: Perfect Participle Active (Ketma-ketlik)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Having + V3..., ega + fe'l...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Perfect Participle Active (Ketma-ketlik). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Having + V3..., ega + fe'l...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Perfect Participle Active (Ketma-ketlik).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Having recognized the obsolescence of fossil fuels, several European nations heavily diversified into offshore wind energy.” Examiner Note: Bir harakat ikkinchisidan aniq oldin tugallanganini bildiradi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Shakl va ma'no. having + uchinchi shakl: having analysed, having completed, having been given. Ma'no: birinchi harakat tugagach, ikkinchisi boshlangan. «Having finished the report, she submitted it» = «After she had finished...».
Passiv shakl. Agar birinchi harakat passiv bo'lsa: having been + V3: «Having been rejected twice, the proposal was finally approved». Bu shakl kamroq uchraydi, lekin akademik matnda to'g'ri va aniq.

Qachon ishlatiladi. Ketma-ketlik muhim bo'lganda va gapni qisqartirish kerak bo'lganda. Ayniqsa tahliliy xatboshilarda: «Having considered both arguments, this essay concludes that...». Bu ibora xulosa uchun juda mos.

Cheklovlar. having + V3 juda rasmiy; oddiy hikoyada sun'iy eshitiladi. Bundan tashqari, ega mosligi saqlanishi shart: «Having finished the report, it was submitted» — xato, chunki hisobot tugatmagan. To'g'risi: «Having finished the report, she submitted it».
units.advanced_source_model: “Having recognized the obsolescence of fossil fuels, several European nations heavily diversified into offshore wind energy.” Examiner Note: Bir harakat ikkinchisidan aniq oldin tugallanganini bildiradi.

units.title: Advanced #17: Absolute Participle Construction (Mustaqil ega)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: With + ot/olmosh + V-ing/V-ed..., bosh gap...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Absolute Participle Construction (Mustaqil ega). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: With + ot/olmosh + V-ing/V-ed..., bosh gap...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Absolute Participle Construction (Mustaqil ega).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “With fossil reserves steadily depleting, investment in renewable alternatives has transitioned from an ideal into an urgent necessity.” Examiner Note: Bosh gapdan mustaqil subyektga ega bo'lgan fon yaratadi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Shakl: with + ot + Ving/V3. with + ot + -ing (aktiv jarayon) yoki with + ot + V3 (passiv holat): «With the population growing rapidly, demand for housing has increased». «With all the tickets sold, the event was a success».

Ma'nosi: fon va sabab. Absolute tuzilma asosiy gap uchun fon yoki sabab yaratadi. U «because» yoki «while» ga o'xshaydi, lekin grammatik jihatdan mustaqil: «With unemployment falling, consumer spending began to recover».

Task 1'da qo'llash. Grafik tavsifida ikki ko'rsatkichni bir gapda bog'lash uchun juda qulay: «With car ownership rising, public transport use declined steadily». Bu tuzilma hisobotni zichlashtiradi va yuqori darajadagi grammatikani ko'rsatadi.

Ehtiyotkorlik. Bu tuzilma yozma va rasmiy uslubga xos bo'lib, haddan tashqari ko'p ishlatilsa matn sun'iy va og'ir eshitiladi. Bitta inshoda bittadan ko'p bo'lmagan absolute tuzilma yetarli. Uni ayniqsa Task 1'da ikki ko'rsatkichni qiyoslash yoki Task 2'da muammoning fonini yaratish uchun ishlating.

units.title: Advanced #21: Inverted First Conditional (Should)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Should + ega + oddiy fe'l, bosh gap...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Inverted First Conditional (Should). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Should + ega + oddiy fe'l, bosh gap...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Inverted First Conditional (Should).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Should the state fail to subsidize vocational apprenticeships, youth unemployment will continue its upward trajectory.” Examiner Note: 'If the state fails...' o'rniga o'ta rasmiy va diplomatik ogohlantirish ohangi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: unless = if not. «Unless the government acts, the problem will grow» = «If the government does not act...». unless o'zi inkor ma'nosini beradi, shuning uchun u bilan not ishlatilmaydi. Rasmiy matnda juda foydali: «Unless funding is increased, services will decline».

provided that / on condition that. Qat'iy shart: «The loan will be approved provided that the applicant has a stable income». as long as bir xil ma'noni beradi, lekin ko'proq davomiylikni ta'kidlaydi: «The scheme will continue as long as funding is available».

in case — boshqa ma'no. in case «ehtimol bo'lsa, oldindan chora ko'rish» ma'nosini beradi va kelajak haqida gapirganda ham hozirgi zamon bilan keladi: «Take an umbrella in case it rains». Bu if bilan bir xil emas: if shartni, in case oldindan ehtiyot chorasini bildiradi.

otherwise va but for. otherwise — «aks holda»: «Governments must act; otherwise the crisis will deepen». but for — «...bo'lmaganida»: «But for the early warning, many people would have died». Bu ikki tuzilma xulosa va tarixiy tahlilda juda samarali.

provided that / on condition that. Qat'iy shart: «The loan will be approved provided that the applicant has a stable income». as long as bir xil ma'noni beradi, lekin ko'proq davomiylikni ta'kidlaydi: «The scheme will continue as long as funding is available».

in case — boshqa ma'no. in case «ehtimol bo'lsa, oldindan chora ko'rish» ma'nosini beradi va kelajak haqida gapirganda ham hozirgi zamon bilan keladi: «Take an umbrella in case it rains». Bu if bilan bir xil emas: if shartni, in case oldindan ehtiyot chorasini bildiradi.

otherwise va but for. otherwise — «aks holda»: «Governments must act; otherwise the crisis will deepen». but for — «...bo'lmaganida»: «But for the early warning, many people would have died». Bu ikki tuzilma xulosa va tarixiy tahlilda juda samarali.

units.title: Advanced #24: Inverted Third Conditional (Had + Subject + V3)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Had + ega + V3, bosh gap (would have + V3)...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Inverted Third Conditional (Had + Subject + V3). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Had + ega + V3, bosh gap (would have + V3)...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Inverted Third Conditional (Had + Subject + V3).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Had stricter anti-monopoly regulations been enforced earlier, tech conglomerates would not have monopolized digital discourse.” Examiner Note: O'tmishdagi xato yoki boy berilgan imkoniyatni tahlil qilish.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Shakl: had + V3, would have + V3. Shart qismida had + uchinchi shakl, natija qismida would have + uchinchi shakl: «If the city had invested in drainage, the flood would not have damaged homes». Ikki qismda ham V3 bo'lishi shart.

Ma'no: o'zgarmas o'tmish. Bu tuzilma o'tmishni o'zgartirib bo'lmasligini bildiradi, shuning uchun u ko'pincha tanqid yoki afsus ohangida keladi: «If policymakers had listened to scientists, thousands of lives would have been saved». Inshoda bu fikrni kuchli qiladi, lekin dalilsiz ishlatilmasligi kerak.

could have va might have. would have o'rniga could have (imkoniyat) yoki might have (ehtimol) kelishi mumkin: «If the tax had been lower, consumption might have risen». Bu variantlar da'voni yumshatadi va noaniqlikni to'g'ri ifodalaydi.

Inkor va savol. Inkor: «If the city had not cut funding, services would not have declined». Savol: «Would the outcome have been different if the policy had been introduced earlier?» Savol shakli inshoda ritorik savol sifatida ishlatilishi mumkin, lekin kamdan-kam.

units.title: Advanced #25: Mixed Conditional 1 (O'tmish sharti -> Hozirgi natija)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: If / Had + ega + V3, ega + would + fe'l (now)...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Mixed Conditional 1 (O'tmish sharti -> Hozirgi natija). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: If / Had + ega + V3, ega + would + fe'l (now)...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Mixed Conditional 1 (O'tmish sharti -> Hozirgi natija).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Had regional authorities invested in flood prevention infrastructure a decade ago, coastal cities would not be so acutely vulnerable today.” Examiner Note: O'tmishdagi sababning bugungi kundagi aniq oqibatini bog'lash.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: O'tmish sabab, hozirgi natija. Shakl: if + had + V3, would + V1. «If the city had invested in public transport, congestion would be lower today». O'tmishdagi qaror hozirgi holatga ta'sir qiladi — bu eng ko'p ishlatiladigan mixed turi.

Hozirgi holat, o'tmish natijasi. Shakl: if + past simple, would have + V3. «If he were more careful, he would not have made that mistake». Bu tur kamroq uchraydi, lekin doimiy xususiyat bilan o'tmishdagi natijani bog'lash uchun kerak.

Qachon ishlatiladi. Bir hodisaning oqibati uzoq davom etsa: «If the factory had not closed, the town would still be prosperous». Yoki doimiy xarakter bilan o'tmishdagi xato bog'lansa: «If she were more organised, she would have met the deadline».

Ehtiyotkorlik. Mixed conditional mantiqan juda aniq bo'lishi kerak. Agar ikki qism orasidagi vaqt bog'lanishi shubhali bo'lsa, oddiy second yoki third conditional ishlatgan ma'qul. Imtihonda noto'g'ri mixed gap oddiy to'g'ri gapdan ko'ra ko'proq zarar keltiradi.
1   If the city had invested in public transport, congestion would be lower today.

units.title: Advanced #28: Conditional Conjunction: Provided / Providing that
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Bosh gap, provided that + shart gapi...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Conditional Conjunction: Provided / Providing that. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Bosh gap, provided that + shart gapi...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Conditional Conjunction: Provided / Providing that.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Remote working models can amplify overall productivity, provided that employers maintain clear boundaries against overwork.” Examiner Note: Shartning qat'iy va cheklovchi xususiyatini ko'rsatish.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: unless = if not. «Unless the government acts, the problem will grow» = «If the government does not act...». unless o'zi inkor ma'nosini beradi, shuning uchun u bilan not ishlatilmaydi. Rasmiy matnda juda foydali: «Unless funding is increased, services will decline».

provided that / on condition that. Qat'iy shart: «The loan will be approved provided that the applicant has a stable income». as long as bir xil ma'noni beradi, lekin ko'proq davomiylikni ta'kidlaydi: «The scheme will continue as long as funding is available».

in case — boshqa ma'no. in case «ehtimol bo'lsa, oldindan chora ko'rish» ma'nosini beradi va kelajak haqida gapirganda ham hozirgi zamon bilan keladi: «Take an umbrella in case it rains». Bu if bilan bir xil emas: if shartni, in case oldindan ehtiyot chorasini bildiradi.

otherwise va but for. otherwise — «aks holda»: «Governments must act; otherwise the crisis will deepen». but for — «...bo'lmaganida»: «But for the early warning, many people would have died». Bu ikki tuzilma xulosa va tarixiy tahlilda juda samarali.

units.title: Advanced #31: It-Cleft (Egani bo'rttirish)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: It is/was + ega + that/who + qolgan qism...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: It-Cleft (Egani bo'rttirish). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: It is/was + ega + that/who + qolgan qism...
2. Asosiy vazifa: It-Cleft (Egani bo'rttirish).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “It is early childhood parental interaction that primarily determines an individual's linguistic capability.” Examiner Note: Boshqa omillar emas, aynan mana shu element muhimligini ko'rsatadi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: It + be + ta'kid + that. Gapning muhim bo'lagi it is/was dan keyinga chiqariladi: «It is governments that must act», «It was the tax that reduced consumption». Bu tuzilma sabab yoki javobgarlikni aniq ko'rsatadi va ohangni kuchaytiradi.

units.title: Advanced #33: Wh-Cleft / Pseudo-Cleft with 'What'
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: What + ega + fe'l + is/was + ot/to-inf/that...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Wh-Cleft / Pseudo-Cleft with 'What'. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: What + ega + fe'l + is/was + ot/to-inf/that...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Wh-Cleft / Pseudo-Cleft with 'What'.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “What contemporary societies urgently require is an ethical reassessment of consumerist culture.” Examiner Note: Ehtiyoj yoki maqsadni emfatik (ta'sirchan) shaklda taqdim etadi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: It + be + ta'kid + that. Gapning muhim bo'lagi it is/was dan keyinga chiqariladi: «It is governments that must act», «It was the tax that reduced consumption». Bu tuzilma sabab yoki javobgarlikni aniq ko'rsatadi va ohangni kuchaytiradi.

What ... is/was. What bilan boshlanuvchi cleft: «What matters most is access to clean water», «What the report reveals is a steady decline». Bu tuzilma xulosa va asosiy fikrni ajratib ko'rsatish uchun juda mos.

All / The only thing + that. «All the government needs to do is invest in training», «The only thing that has changed is the scale of the problem». Bu shakllar cheklov va urg'u beradi, lekin kamdan-kam ishlatilishi kerak.

Inshodagi o'rni. Cleft sentence xulosa yoki asosiy da'vo uchun ideal: «It is not the amount of aid that matters, but how it is distributed». Biroq haddan tashqari ko'p ishlatilsa, matn sun'iy va retorik bo'lib qoladi.

units.title: Advanced #36: Causal Cleft: The reason why... is that
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: The primary reason why + gap + is that + gap...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Causal Cleft: The reason why... is that. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: The primary reason why + gap + is that + gap...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Causal Cleft: The reason why... is that.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “The primary reason why traditional print journalism is declining is that digital platforms provide instantaneous news aggregation.” Examiner Note: Sabab-oqibatni tahliliy formatda chuqur yoritish.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: It + be + ta'kid + that. Gapning muhim bo'lagi it is/was dan keyinga chiqariladi: «It is governments that must act», «It was the tax that reduced consumption». Bu tuzilma sabab yoki javobgarlikni aniq ko'rsatadi va ohangni kuchaytiradi.

What ... is/was. What bilan boshlanuvchi cleft: «What matters most is access to clean water», «What the report reveals is a steady decline». Bu tuzilma xulosa va asosiy fikrni ajratib ko'rsatish uchun juda mos.

All / The only thing + that. «All the government needs to do is invest in training», «The only thing that has changed is the scale of the problem». Bu shakllar cheklov va urg'u beradi, lekin kamdan-kam ishlatilishi kerak.

Inshodagi o'rni. Cleft sentence xulosa yoki asosiy da'vo uchun ideal: «It is not the amount of aid that matters, but how it is distributed». Biroq haddan tashqari ko'p ishlatilsa, matn sun'iy va retorik bo'lib qoladi.

units.title: Advanced #41: Impersonal Passive with Anticipatory 'It'
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: It is widely held/argued/asserted that + gap...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Impersonal Passive with Anticipatory 'It'. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: It is widely held/argued/asserted that + gap...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Impersonal Passive with Anticipatory 'It'.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “It is widely held that punitive fines alone do not suffice to deter multinational corporations from illegal waste dumping.” Examiner Note: Jamiyatda mavjud umumiy konsensusni neytral taqdim etish.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: It + passiv + that. Eng keng tarqalgan tuzilma: It is said/believed/argued/claimed/reported that + gap. «It is often argued that homework improves discipline». Bunday gaplar xolis ohang beradi va muallif pozitsiyasini orqaga suradi.

There is + ot + that. «There is growing evidence that», «There is little doubt that», «There is a widespread belief that» — mavjudlikni bildiruvchi tuzilmalar. Ular dalilga asoslangan da'vo uchun juda mos va matnga xilma-xillik qo'shadi.

Shaxssiz + to + infinitiv. «The policy is believed to have reduced poverty», «The scheme is said to be effective». Bu tuzilma ikki fikrni bir gapga jamlaydi va yuqori darajadagi grammatikani ko'rsatadi. Vaqtni infinitiv shakli ko'rsatadi: to reduce (hozir), to have reduced (o'tmish).

Muallif pozitsiyasini qanday saqlash. Shaxssiz tuzilmalar fikrni yashirmaydi: «It is argued that» kim tomonidan aytilganini ko'rsatmaydi. Inshoda o'z pozitsiyangizni ham aniq bildiring: «While this view has some merit, the evidence suggests that...». Aks holda Task Response bo'yicha ball tushadi.

units.title: Advanced #51: Inverted Concession: Adjective + As / Though + Subject + Verb
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Sifat + though/as + ega + may be, bosh gap...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Inverted Concession: Adjective + As / Though + Subject + Verb. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Sifat + though/as + ega + may be, bosh gap...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Inverted Concession: Adjective + As / Though + Subject + Verb.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Costly though space exploration initiatives may be, they yield unprecedented spin-off innovations in materials science.” Examiner Note: 'Although they may be costly' o'rniga qo'llanuvchi eng nafis akademik ibora.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Qo'shish. moreover, furthermore, in addition, additionally, also, besides. «Moreover» va «furthermore» rasmiy, «also» neytral, «besides» ko'proq og'zaki. Ular gap boshida vergul bilan yoki gap o'rtasida keladi.

Qarama-qarshilik. however, nevertheless, nonetheless, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, although. «However» eng ko'p ishlatiladigan, lekin har xatboshida takrorlansa matn sun'iy bo'ladi. Almashtirib turing: nevertheless, in contrast, by contrast.

Sabab va natija. because, since, as, due to, therefore, consequently, as a result, thus. «Therefore» va «consequently» natijani bildiradi va rasmiy. «Because of» predlogli birikma, «because» bog'lovchi: «because of the rain» va «because it rained».

Misol va xulosa. for example, for instance, such as, namely; in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance. «Such as» ro'yxat kiritadi, «for example» alohida misol. Xulosa uchun «in conclusion» yetarli — «to sum up» bilan birga ishlatilmaydi.

units.title: Advanced #53: Much as + Clause
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Much as + ega + fe'l, bosh gap...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Much as + Clause. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Much as + ega + fe'l, bosh gap...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Much as + Clause.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Much as critics decry contemporary consumerism, it remains the predominant engine of modern economic growth.” Examiner Note: 'Although critics decry... very much' ma'nosida.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Qo'shish. moreover, furthermore, in addition, additionally, also, besides. «Moreover» va «furthermore» rasmiy, «also» neytral, «besides» ko'proq og'zaki. Ular gap boshida vergul bilan yoki gap o'rtasida keladi.

Qarama-qarshilik. however, nevertheless, nonetheless, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, although. «However» eng ko'p ishlatiladigan, lekin har xatboshida takrorlansa matn sun'iy bo'ladi. Almashtirib turing: nevertheless, in contrast, by contrast.

Sabab va natija. because, since, as, due to, therefore, consequently, as a result, thus. «Therefore» va «consequently» natijani bildiradi va rasmiy. «Because of» predlogli birikma, «because» bog'lovchi: «because of the rain» va «because it rained».

Misol va xulosa. for example, for instance, such as, namely; in conclusion, to sum up, overall, on balance. «Such as» ro'yxat kiritadi, «for example» alohida misol. Xulosa uchun «in conclusion» yetarli — «to sum up» bilan birga ishlatilmaydi.

units.title: Advanced #61: Preposition + Relative Pronoun (Formal style)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Ot + preposition + which/whom + ega + fe'l...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Preposition + Relative Pronoun (Formal style). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Ot + preposition + which/whom + ega + fe'l...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Preposition + Relative Pronoun (Formal style).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “The governance structure through which philanthropic funds are dispersed must remain completely transparent.” Examiner Note: Gap oxirida predlog qoldirishdan saqlanish (preposition stranding ni yo'qotish).
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Shakl va olmoshlar. who — shaxslar uchun, which — narsalar uchun, that — ikkisi uchun ham (defining'da), whose — egalik, where — joy, when — vaqt. «Students who live on campus tend to participate more». that ko'pincha who/which o'rnida ishlatiladi.

Vergul qo'yilmaydi. Defining clause gapning ajralmas qismi: «The policy that was introduced in 2015 reduced emissions». Agar vergul qo'yilsa, ma'no o'zgaradi va u non-defining bo'lib qoladi (44-dars). Imtihonda bu farq muhim.

To'ldiruvchi olmosh tushirilishi. Agar olmosh gapda to'ldiruvchi bo'lsa, uni tushirish mumkin: «The report (which) the committee published was critical». Lekin ega bo'lsa tushirilmaydi: «The students who passed the exam...» — who ni olib tashlab bo'lmaydi.

Task 1 va Task 2'da. Task 1'da otni aniqlashtirish: «The proportion of people who work from home rose». Task 2'da ta'rif va shart: «Policies that target low-income families are more effective». Bu tuzilma matnga aniqlik va zichlik qo'shadi.

units.title: Advanced #71: Mandative Subjunctive with Verbs (recommend that)
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: Ega + recommend/demand/insist + that + ega + (bare inf)...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Mandative Subjunctive with Verbs (recommend that). Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: Ega + recommend/demand/insist + that + ega + (bare inf)...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Mandative Subjunctive with Verbs (recommend that).

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “Economists strongly recommend that every developing state eliminate tariffs on essential agricultural imports.” Examiner Note: Fe'l 3-shaxs birlikda bo'lsa ham qo'shimcha (-s/-es) olmaydi: 'state eliminate'.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Fe'ldan keyin. that-clause ko'pincha fikrlash va aytish fe'llaridan keyin keladi: argue that, suggest that, show that, believe that, claim that, indicate that. «The data suggest that the trend is slowing». Bu tuzilma inshoda dalil keltirishning standart shakli.

The fact that. «The fact that» iborasi mavjudlikni ta'kidlaydi va gap boshida ega bo'lib keladi: «The fact that millions lack clean water is unacceptable». Bu tuzilma muammoni kuchli ifodalaydi, lekin uni ko'p ishlatish matnni og'irlashtiradi.

It + sifat + that. «It is clear that», «It is essential that», «It is worrying that». Bu tuzilmalar xolis baho beradi va shaxsiy fikrni orqaga suradi: «It is evident that the current system is unsustainable».

that tushirilishi. So'zlashuv uslubida that ko'pincha tushiriladi: «I think (that) he is right». Akademik yozuvda that ni saqlash aniqroq va rasmiyroq. Ayniqsa gap uzun bo'lsa, that o'quvchiga yordam beradi.

units.title: Advanced #81: Proportional Comparative: The more... the more...
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: The + comparative..., the + comparative...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Proportional Comparative: The more... the more.... Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: The + comparative..., the + comparative...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Proportional Comparative: The more... the more....

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “The more sophisticated artificial neural networks become, the more opaque their internal decision-making matrices appear.” Examiner Note: Ikki o'zgaruvchining to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'zaro bog'liqligini (proportionality) ko'rsatadi.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Qisqa va uzun sifatlar. Bir bo'g'inli sifatlarga -er qo'shiladi: higher, cheaper, larger. Ikki va undan ortiq bo'g'inlilarda more ishlatiladi: more expensive, more efficient. Ikkisini birga ishlatish xato: «more higher».

than va as ... as. Qiyosiy daraja than bilan: «higher than in 2010». Tenglik as ... as bilan: «as expensive as»; inkor not as ... as: «not as high as». «Than» o'rniga «then» yozish — tez-tez uchraydigan imlo xatosi.

Noto'g'ri shakllar. good — better, bad — worse, far — further, little — less, many/much — more. Bu shakllar -er yoki more olmaydi: «gooder», «more better», «more worse» — barchasi xato. Imtihonda eng ko'p uchraydigan xato aynan «more better» birikmasidir.

Task 1'da qiyoslash. «Twice as high as», «three times more than», «slightly higher than», «considerably lower than». Bu tuzilmalar raqamlarni izohlashda aniqlik beradi: «The figure was twice as high as in 2000».
units.advanced_source_model: “The more sophisticated artificial neural networks become, the more opaque their internal decision-making matrices appear.” Examiner Note: Ikki o'zgaruvchining to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'zaro bog'liqligini (proportionality) ko'rsatadi.

examples.en: The more people use public transport, the less traffic there is on the roads.
examples.uz: Odamlar jamoat transportidan qancha ko‘p foydalansa, yo‘llarda tirbandlik shuncha kam bo‘ladi.

examples.en: Housing costs are considerably higher than in 2010.

units.title: Advanced #91: Nominalised Cause-and-Effect
units.simple_explanation: Bu yanada murakkabroq gap qolipi. Uning ichidagi so‘zlar tartibi odatdagidan farq qilishi mumkin. Avval oddiy gapni tushuning, keyin faqat kerak bo‘lsa shu yuqori darajadagi tartibga o‘tkazing. Xatosiz sodda gap har doim xatoli murakkab gapdan yaxshiroq.
units.formula: The + ot + of + ot + resulted in / brought about + ot...
units.specific_rule: Bu tuzilma: Nominalised Cause-and-Effect. Yuqoridagi formulani o‘qing va ega (subject), yordamchi fe’l (auxiliary), asosiy fe’l (verb) tartibini alohida tekshiring.
steps: 1. Formula: The + ot + of + ot + resulted in / brought about + ot...
2. Asosiy vazifa: Nominalised Cause-and-Effect.

3. Matndan qayerga urg‘u berilayotganini toping: “The uncontrolled commodification of municipal real estate triggered the systematic displacement of working-class residents.” Examiner Note: 'Because real estate was commercialized, residents were displaced' o'rniga sofdil akademik uslub.
4. O‘zingizning sodda gapingizni aylantiring, lekin hech qachon faqat qiyin ko‘rinishi uchun qo‘shmang.
warnings: Yuqori daraja biror avtomatik IELTS 9.0 kafolatini bermaydi.
Misol va tanlangan tuzilma mos kelishini qo‘lda tekshiring.
Quyidagi ikki tilli misollar yondosh grammatik baza sifatida berilgan; hammasi ham aynan shu advanced formulaga misol emas.
deep_rules: Fe'ldan ot. increase → an increase in, decrease → a decrease in, grow → growth, develop → development, fail → failure, improve → improvement, reduce → a reduction in, consume → consumption. «Prices increased» → «the increase in prices»; «Emissions fell» → «the fall in emissions».

Sifatdan ot. difficult → difficulty, important → importance, able → ability, likely → likelihood, poor → poverty, strong → strength. «It is difficult to access» → «the difficulty of access». Bu o'zgarishlar matnni rasmiylashtiradi.

Gapni qisqartirish. «Because the population is ageing, costs are rising» → «Population ageing has pushed up costs». «The government decided to act» → «The government's decision to act». Nominalizatsiya ikki gapni bitta zich gapga aylantiradi.

Me'yor. Har bir gapni nominalizatsiya qilish matnni sun'iy va o'qish qiyin holga keltiradi. Eng yaxshi uslub — aralashtirish: mavhum tahlil uchun nominalizatsiya, harakat va sabab uchun fe'l. «The reduction in funding led to the closure of clinics» — yaxshi, lekin «The reduction in funding caused the decrease in the provision of services» — ortiqcha.
